title: Complete the authenticated realtime result boundary

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Realtime boundary integration tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/promo/test_realtime_attempt_integration.py tests/promo/test_ft004_correctness.py

evidence_required: FT-004-AC-004 RED: the current nonzero public route ends internal_failure and has no controlled correctness rows; GREEN: one stable twenty-Attempt corpus records a manual pilot evaluator decision for all four teasers and every complete-union photo_id, and at least nineteen server-correctness rows contain only participants represented by processed selected detections while missed group members remain allowed; decisive comparison: per-Attempt ground-truth table and 19/20 count; artifact: redacted corpus manifest and reviewer record under .tasks/TASK-075-T3-FT-004-W5/. This task does not claim the later FT-005 QR/latency join.

FT-004-AC-005 RED: the current integrated result route lacks final proof of the completed display-Bearer hash authentication and deterministic test rate limiter; GREEN: preserve and re-prove through the final result route token-derived SPA only, rejection of absent/foreign/body override, configured per-token/IP 429 behavior and zero token/header/digest material in persisted/searchable logs; decisive comparison: public requests, owner rows and redacted log scan; artifact: security evidence under .tasks/TASK-075-T3-FT-004-W5/.

FT-004-AC-006 RED: nonzero insufficient/partial/repeated-Photo cases cannot reach typed domain outcomes and missing context has no completed operational evidence check; GREEN: missing date returns pre-admission 503 with bounded token-free evidence, partial current ready inventory is searched without a group gate, fewer than four returns insufficient_results with no session, repeated Photo contributes once to N, and every exact result/non-success response follows response version 1; decisive comparison: response/Attempt/session/evidence rows for each fixture; artifact: boundary integration evidence under .tasks/TASK-075-T3-FT-004-W5/.
purpose: Compose the completed serving, processing and promo outcomes behind the exact authenticated realtime endpoint and prove the remaining FT-004 public, correctness, security and non-success claims.
success_outcome: A valid bounded nonzero request reaches one full result or exact typed non-success through the public HTTPS route, preserves token-bound scope and idempotency, and produces the controlled server-correctness evidence without moving business rules into transport wiring.
anti_goals: Do not reimplement or re-own dependency claims for authentication, context, selection, search, assembly, persistence, slot or recovery.
Do not implement FT-005 rendering/acknowledgement/cooldown, FT-006 phone continuation or FT-007 detailed evidence.
Do not claim the final joint QR/under-10-second verdict or add production deployment actions.

forbidden_scope: SpaPromoClient rendering/state, QR phone flow and detailed diagnostics UI/storage
Model download/fallback, ANN, waiter/replay infrastructure or another runtime role
Production secrets, operator/default rows or unredacted participant/credential artifacts
stop_conditions: The public route would need business orchestration in the FastAPI handler or a generic helper.
A complete outcome cannot be formed through the accepted Boundary Map edges and canonical response contract.
The controlled corpus or T3 security probe would require unauthorized production data/action or could not be isolated and cleaned safely.
A product target or pass/fail rule beyond FT-004-AC-004..006 remains undecided.

constraints: Keep the FastAPI entrypoint to authentication, validation, adapter binding, transaction/lifecycle wiring and response serialization; promo owns the use case.
Use explicit deterministic per-token/IP limits in tests and deployment-configured positive runtime values; never queue rate-limited requests.

Use task-owned display client, serving context, Photo/face/Attempt/session/corpus fixtures with known initial state, safe rerun identifiers, observable final rows and cleanup limited to those fixtures.
The controlled corpus names stable Attempt IDs and a manual pilot evaluator role/criterion; redact credentials and unnecessary participant identity from retained artifacts.
invariants: Transport rejection creates no core Attempt; every admitted request creates exactly one and terminal repeats run no second inference.
The body cannot override token-derived SPA and token/header/digest material never enters logs.
No-success, deadline, busy, interrupted or internal failure publishes a result session.
FT-004 server-correctness evidence remains joinable to later FT-005 Attempt IDs without claiming its QR/latency proof.
verification_targets: FT-004-AC-004 controlled twenty-row manual correctness review records decisive participant/detection membership and the 19/20 server count.
FT-004-AC-005 public-boundary fixtures prove hashed token scope, override rejection, 429 behavior and log redaction through result and non-success branches.
FT-004-AC-006 integration fixtures prove missing-date, partial-ready, insufficient-result and repeated-Photo outcomes with exact Attempt/session effects.
